page.layout: One column of running text, with three numbered entries, each headed by a title line. Left and right margins hold no printed notes; the cut-off fragments at the left edge belong to the neighbouring page. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: Ruff. RHODON CYPARISSO. LXXI.
Lucanos iterum obveniffe dicunt. ideo abiecta
falce, hastam & stimulum fabricabo, & artem bel-li-
cam exercebo. non enim nos ociari patitur Deus:
mihi hyeme æstas est gelidior. nam quid bello fit
horridius? vere adueniente fleui. quam comatus
ager stat floribus, quam odoratus a myrtis agellus,
quam ornata spissa ista platanus? virct[?] triticum,
omnia mihi ad abundantiam festinant. sed malum
nobis dant hostes. exoptabilior enim iis ensis
est aratro.
Amat. SOPATER TELESILLÆ. LXXII.
Nisi venereis voluptatibus invenustam satieta-
tem miscuiffet natura, seruiret iam sexus masculus
feminino, Telesilla. Non igitur superbias, merca-
tricula. Veneris mihi fax iam emortua est. neque
dolores immortales amorum tela faciunt.
Eth. PROCLVS ARCHIMEDI. LXXIII.
Polypos dicunt in capturæ penuria, tricas fuas
deuorare, membra fua nimirum miserrima, tan-
quam opsonium recuera[?] apparatum. Eduntigitur
infelices membrorum suorum partes tenuissimas,
& oftenduntur comedones esse propriæ carnis. Vt
vero Xanthippe non omnibus habere polypi men-
tem videaris, saltem fane ego illud esse creado certis-
simum. Tractas enim nimis inhumaniter tuum pa-
trem, neque naturam veritus, neq; poenam, quem-
admodum barathrum timeri solet metuens. Sed si

page.notes: Ruff. and Amat. are abbreviations as I read them; Amat. is uncertain. "recuera" in the Procl. entry is uncertain (possibly "recuerat"). "virct" is probably "virct" as printed, with possible misprint for "virct"/"viret". Greek-letter abbreviation "Eth." is uncertain. Left-edge fragments are from the neighbouring page and were omitted. Spellings with ff and long s were copied as printed, with long s written as s.
